summary: Unit test on server_default_config_text(clipboard=None) checks exact fallback bindings (copy-selection-and-cancel, tmux's own paste-buffer primitive) for both drag-release binds and the double-click copy action, and asserts no copy-pipe-and-cancel remains anywhere; the same clipboard=None config is separately proven to be valid, loadable tmux syntax by a real-tmux test elsewhere in the file.
